facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but foreign currency must be surrendered to an approved bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Only with Finance Minister authorisation after a BCEAO opinion.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register as an entreprenant at the Maison de l'Entreprise in Niamey, about 72 hours.
facts.L2_tax_id: NIF, reportedly issued with your registration at the Maison de l'Entreprise.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Under FCFA 50m turnover, a synthetic tax applies; no start-up exemption since 2025.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 19% VAT; platform sales are taxable since 2025.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 2022-59: notify the HAPDP, unless you appoint a data protection officer.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Electronic transactions law 2019-03 exists; refund rules not confirmed.
facts.L7_incentives: No small-business tax holiday since 2025; the synthetic regime is the simplified option.
facts.D1_id_document: National identity card; AES biometric cards rolling out since 2026.
